remarks: All offers are respectfully requested by Monday, May 4th at 3:00 PM, please include full details with submission. Sparkling and bright, this move-in ready home offers surprising space across five beautifully finished levels, thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. Sunlight fills the interiors, complemented by a long list of thoughtful updates and improvements that reflect a high level of care and meticulous maintenance throughout. A covered front porch sets a gracious tone on arrival, inviting quiet mornings and relaxed evenings, while the expansive rear deck and luxurious hot tub are perfectly suited for unwinding or gathering with friends. Set on a lovely, flat property with beautiful flowering trees, the home offers a rare sense of space and privacy while still being close to everything. Ideally located just moments from town, with easy access to schools, parks, and daily amenities, you'll enjoy nearby tennis and pickleball courts at Town Farm Park, along with the dog park and open green space at Winslow Park for picnicking and easy recreation. Restaurants, shopping, and all that makes Westport so special are close at hand, creating an easy, enjoyable lifestyle in a truly inviting setting.
